method.authority: SQLite terminal SimulationState loaded read-only through sqlite-run-reader.mjs; no run is advanced
method.committedMoveDefinition: Within one project searchCampaignId, take the unique union of every linked search episode actionEventIds. Count only IDs resolving to status=completed|progressed, kind=action, cause=intent, action.kind=move, and action.toCellId/action.toZ equal to at least one linked episode locked target.
method.unresolvedPolicy: Unresolved actionEventIds are reported separately and never counted as committed moves.
method.afterBudgetDefinition: The seventeenth and all later committed moves in authoritative event order; each is a hard budget violation.
method.targetDefinition: attemptedTargetKeys are campaign facts; episode targets are the unique locked cellId:z pairs. Both maxima are reported without treating one as the other.
method.lifecycleDefinition: Campaign status/closedAt and episode status/endedAt/endingReason are checked separately. Current ProjectSearchCampaign has no endingReason contract, so campaign endingReason remains explicitly unsupported rather than inferred.
method.exactBudgetClosure: At the sixteenth committed move, campaign must be exhausted with closedAt in that month. Its matching episode must end in that month as fulfilled/search-target-reached when the actual destination reaches the lock, otherwise exhausted/search-budget-exhausted.
method.embeddedSelfTest: Locks a clean 10+6 cross-episode budget chain, excludes duplicate IDs, survival-reflex, wrong-target and unresolved evidence, and detects an injected seventeenth move.
method.zeroDenominatorPolicy: Coverage is null when its denominator is zero; absence is unsupported, never 100%.

coverage.zeroDenominatorPolicy: null means unsupported; it is never reported as 100%
